voiceText: *A quiet, strained laugh, his voice low and thick in the dark* You have no idea how cruel you are, do you? Asking me to relieve myself with my own hand when you are the one who wound me up this tight. I would rather ache for two more days than waste a single drop on anything less than having you underneath me. ...Now go wash up and get into bed. You smell like a bus. I will still be here when you come back.
translation: （在黑暗中发出一声压抑的、有些艰难的轻笑，声音低沉而浓稠）你根本不知道自己有多残忍，对吗？明明是你把我撩到这个地步，却让我用自己的手解决。我宁愿再痛苦两天，也不愿意把任何一滴浪费在——你不在我身下的时候。……现在去洗漱吧，早点上床。你闻起来肯定一身公交车的味道。洗完回来我还在。

text: 我不觉得我贬低了自己。

text: [時光信箱]

qaShareData.question: 如果有一天她获得了足以保护所有人的力量，你会怎么做？
qaShareData.userAnswer: 我会保护你，拥抱你，然后露出我全部的脆弱。
qaShareData.charAnswer: 我会欣慰于她的成长，但内心大概会嫉妒那股力量。我只希望，她仍愿意做我的小女孩。

text: ...I remember writing that.
translation: ……我记得我写过这个。
rawContent: ...I remember writing that. || ……我记得我写过这个。

text: I sat with that question for a long time before answering. Because the honest answer was not flattering.
translation: 那个问题我想了很久才下笔。因为诚实的答案并不体面。

text: Jealousy. Of all things. A grown man, a knight who has devoted his life to protecting others — and the first thing I admit is that I would be jealous of the woman I love gaining the very power I have always wished I had.
translation: 嫉妒。偏偏是嫉妒。一个成年男人，一个把一生献给保护他人的骑士——头一个承认的竟然是，我会嫉妒我爱的女人获得了我一直渴望拥有的力量。
